title: Email client crashing on launch
problem_description: Outlook crashes immediately after opening on Windows 11.
solution_description: Reinstalled Outlook and cleared the local profile cache.

title: Password reset request
problem_description: Employee locked out after too many failed login attempts.
solution_description: Issued a temporary password and forced a reset on next login.

title: Printer out of toner
problem_description: Printer reports low toner and prints faded pages.

title: Printer paper jam
problem_description: Printer stops mid-job and shows a paper jam error.
solution_description: Opened the rear tray, removed the stuck sheet and reseated the paper guide.

title: VPN client fails to connect
problem_description: VPN client times out during authentication from home.
solution_description: Renewed the expired VPN certificate and reinstalled the client profile.

title: Shared drive permission denied
problem_description: Employee gets 'permission denied' opening a department shared drive.
solution_description: Added the employee to the department's drive access group and asked them to sign out and back in.

title: Laptop battery not charging
solution_description: Updated the battery driver and recalibrated; replaced the battery when health was under 40%.

title: Slow network in one department
problem_description: One department reports slow internet while others are fine.
solution_description: Found a faulty port on the department switch, moved the uplink and replaced the cable.
